$comment: Golden cases for how a version arrived, read back (SPEC §4, §17). functions/test/provenance.test.js asserts originOf (functions/src/lib/versions.ts) gives `origin` for each version record, and app/src/components/DetailsPanel.test.tsx asserts the app's originOfVersion (app/src/provenance.ts), which reads versions from Firestore itself, gives the same, so a version written before `origin` was stored reads the same on both sides.

cases.name: origin, where stored, is the answer
a copy from before lineage, under the older name of a fork
an older upload through the CLI
an older upload in the browser
